legs.name: portability gate (tracked files reference nothing outside this repo)

note: Declared with the paths-discipline consolidation (2026-11-13): the package carried no gate.json; this declaration adds it to the composed gate with its standing suite and the paths leg. The suite leg is isolation-wrapped (2026-11-13) over the package's real state homes — var/ (the production release record's home) and state/ (the stores' default home) — so a test that touches real state fails the leg even when every test passes. The portability enrollment (2026-11-14, genericity pass) adds the denylist-carrying component leg in the registry form, fail_on_denylist auto. The writer-uniqueness leg (AC-14 invariant (b), static half, 2026-11-15): the platform-first declaration of gate.writeruniqueness — one unified writer (contract 15, §4.15), no truncate-write of a state-shaped path and no duplicate staged-write implementation outside writer.py; per-package adoption elsewhere follows as separate commissions, and the invariant's live-store half is the suite's writer census (tests/test_writer_uniqueness.py). The date-uniqueness leg (2026-11-16, dup-2026-11-16): one shared date helper per intent per cluster — gate.dateuniqueness over the family map in gate/date_families.json.
